name: docs check / validate
description:
Schema, undeclared kinds, dead paths, anchor resolution (moved/changed/broken), manual status vs linked issue states (planned with InProgress issues, shipped with open issues), rendered CLAUDE.md block out of date.
Same exit codes and --strict semantics as issues validate; --fix for moved anchors and timestamp conflicts.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged b8b933d. docs check (alias validate) [--strict] [--fix] [--json]. Errors: InvalidFile, schema kinds, MergeConflict, BrokenAnchor. Warnings: MovedAnchor (fixable), ChangedAnchor, FuzzyAnchor, DeadPath, StatusMismatch, MissingIssue, StaleClaudeMd (fixable). --fix runs, under the lock: ResolveConflicts, StampHandEdits, a fix of moved anchors only, then a re-render. JSON: a problem array, or { fixed, problems } with --fix. The problem table moved to RepoCli.Core/Cli/ProblemTable. After merging: anchor content for timestamps is now body hash + span only, so hint fixes go through the normal Save and SaveHintFix is removed. For #31/#32: DocsChecker returns only a CheckReport, so expose the anchor resolutions per address; DeadPath matches paths literally (share one matcher with #32); plain check can't report unstamped edits without a read-only query.
